ابتعثتا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَعَثَتَا (ibtaʕaṯatā) /ib.ta.ʕa.θa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# اُبْتُعِثَتَا (ubtuʕiṯatā) /ub.tu.ʕi.θa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
